items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Wood Stroller lived right across the street from me, you know, came out of the same neighborhood.

ctx.x: I mean Duke’s father was a professional butler too.

You know, it was like everybody was sort of -- I mean everybody was going ­ - there were no virtually wealthy people in my area that you could, you know, shake a stick at, that type of thing. As a matter of fact, what the hell is his name? Wood Stroller lived right across the street from me, you know, came out of the same neighborhood.
What elementary school did you go to, do you remember that?
